name: io.github.98Woonho/db-scout-mcp
title: DB Scout
description: Read-only DB explorer for AI agents: schema, join paths, safe SELECT, PII masking. Needs Java 21

environmentVariables.name: DB_SCOUT_URL
environmentVariables.description: JDBC URL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite). Leave empty to use the built-in Sakila sample DB

environmentVariables.name: DB_SCOUT_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: DB user (a read-only account is recommended). Leave empty for SQLite

environmentVariables.name: DB_SCOUT_MASK_COLUMNS
environmentVariables.description: Extra columns to mask, comma-separated (e.g. member.name, member.nickname=secret)

environmentVariables.name: DB_SCOUT_HIDDEN_TABLES
environmentVariables.description: Tables to hide from tools and block in queries, comma-separated
